name: Energy Soldier (Combat)
body:
Benefit(s): Any ability that would enable you ignore any amount damage reduction also enables you to ignore the same amount of energy resistance under the same circumstances (for example, you may use the Clustered

Shots feat to total the damage from all attacks made with a laser rifle or +1 flaming longbow before applying fire resistance).
